narrative.intro: C J Mahan Construction shows $215M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. C J Mahan Construction has 12 awards so far, with an average award size of $17.9M. C J Mahan Construction obligations are up 247.4% year over year. Historical obligations by fiscal year show $66.4M in FY21, $7.2M in FY22, $24.1M in FY23, $52.9M in FY24, and $61.9M in FY25. C J Mahan Construction is concentrated in Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction with $212M in obligations in FY2026 to date. C J Mahan Construction also has $3M in Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction and $204K in Ship Building and Repairing for the same period. The page covers FY2026 to date and notes that figures are contract obligations except where award-value figures are shown in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables. The current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is still in progress.

sections.heading: How has C J Mahan Construction’s federal business trended recently?
sections.body: C J Mahan Construction obligations are $215M in FY2026 to date, up 247.4% year over year. C J Mahan Construction had $61.9M in FY25 and previous-year totals of $52.9M in FY24, $24.1M in FY23, $7.2M in FY22, and $66.4M in FY21.
